conventions.testing: Unit tests in mod tests blocks with SemanticExtractor integration
conventions.linting: clippy with -D warnings, just lint/lint-fix commands

patterns: LanguageInfo struct with element_query, call_query, reference_query, import_query, defuse_query
Language-specific module with ELEMENT_QUERY, CALL_QUERY, REFERENCE_QUERY, IMPORT_QUERY, DEFUSE_QUERY constants
constraints: DEFUSE_QUERY is mandatory for all languages
No impl_query or impl_trait_query for Swift (no impl blocks)
Swift declaration kinds (class/struct/actor/enum/extension) use class_declaration node with declaration_kind field
test_coverage: Existing language modules have unit tests for element_query, extract_inheritance, and defuse_query. Java tests verify ELEMENT_QUERY compilation, extract_inheritance with extends/implements, and defuse_query write sites.

library_findings.notes: alex-pinkus/tree-sitter-swift; dev-only tree-sitter dependency; no version conflict with workspace tree-sitter 0.26.13
Normal dependency of tree-sitter-swift; provides into() conversion

approaches.name: Direct Java Pattern Adaptation
approaches.description: Create swift.rs following java.rs structure: ELEMENT_QUERY for function_declaration/class_declaration/protocol_declaration, DEFUSE_QUERY for property_declaration/assignment/call_expression, extract_inheritance walking inheritance_specifier.
cons: Swift declaration_kind field requires runtime filtering

approaches.name: Enhanced Declaration Kind Handling
approaches.description: Add declaration_kind-aware ELEMENT_QUERY patterns using capture groups to distinguish class/struct/actor/enum/extension/protocol at query time.

approaches.name: Minimal Stub Approach
approaches.description: Register Swift with minimal queries (ELEMENT_QUERY only, DEFUSE_QUERY as empty/placeholder), add extract_inheritance stub.

recommendation: Direct Java Pattern Adaptation - follows established codebase patterns, balances completeness with implementation effort, and aligns with issue acceptance criteria.
language_info_struct_citation:
pub struct LanguageInfo {
    pub name: &'static str,
    pub language: Language,
    pub element_query: &'static str,
    pub call_query: &'static str,
    pub reference_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub import_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub impl_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub impl_trait_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub defuse_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub extract_function_name: Option<ExtractFunctionNameHandler>,
    pub find_method_for_receiver: Option<FindMethodForReceiverHandler>,
    pub find_receiver_type: Option<FindReceiverTypeHandler>,
    pub extract_inheritance: Option<ExtractInheritanceHandler>,
}
inheritance_walk_citation: From tree-sitter-swift grammar.js and node-types.json: Walk class_declaration's _inheritance_specifiers children. For each inheritance_specifier node, read the inherits_from field which points to a user_type node. Extract the type_identifier text from user_type's children. Multiple specifiers are comma-separated siblings under _inheritance_specifiers.
